meta.name: Byomkesh
meta.description:
The time is 1930s, and crime is culminating. One man can uproot the sin: Satyanweshi Byomkesh Bakshi. Hoichoi Originals brings Bengal’s popular sleuth in an all-new but familiar avatar.

Returning Series · First aired 14 Oct 2017 · India · Language: Bengali · 45 min
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Not complete. On your server: S1 2/2 | S2 3/3 | S3 2/2 | S4 2/2 | S5 2/2 | S6 3/3 | S7 2/2 | S8 1/4 (missing E2-4)

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Satyanweshi Pother Kanta
videos.overview: Byomkesh disentangles himself as the truth-seeker, who with friend and writer Ajit uncoils the mystery behind the bizarre murders.

videos.title: Makorshar Rosh Artham Anartham
videos.overview: Byomkesh is on one of his private missions with Ajit. As he decides upon setting his foot forward on a new journey, he meets Satyabati for the first time.

videos.title: Rakter Daag - Part 1
videos.overview: Truth seeker Byomkesh indulges in romance and poetry, till a flamboyant Satyakam comes to him with a weird proposal: to investigate his own murder mystery.

videos.title: Rakter Daag - Part 2
videos.overview: Satyakam predicted his murder that has come true. Byomkesh has to reach to the root cause of the murder and find out what lead him to predict his own end.

videos.title: Raktamukhi Neela
videos.overview: A theft at Maharaj Ramendra Singha's palace leads Byomkesh to investigate a royal case of the Blue Sapphire.

videos.title: Shajaru'r Kanta - Part 1
videos.overview: When industrialist Debashish becomes the target of a ruthless murder plan, Byomkesh enters the scene to unmask the person.

videos.title: Shajaru'r Kanta - Part 2
videos.overview: Byomkesh comes to know Debashish has an unhappy marital life with wife Deepa, as she loved someone else. Is the murderer someone really close then?

videos.title: Agnibaan Part 1
videos.overview: A young girl named Rekha dies mysteriously in her home in Byomkesh's neighbourhood. Is this death connected to her secret relationship?

videos.title: Agnibaan Part 2
videos.overview: As Byomkesh gets busy investigating the mystery of the Rekha's demise, another peculiar death occurs in her family.

videos.title: Tetallisher Monwantor
videos.overview: Amidst the deaths during the famine across Bengal, a disturbed Byomkesh receives a letter. Can he fulfill the last wish of a man predicting his own death?

videos.title: Khnuji Khnuji Nari
videos.overview: Byomkesh discovers a letter that Rameshwar sent to a man named Bishu, with a strange message. Is there a mysterious connection between Rameshwar and Bishu?

videos.title: Hena-Monyota
videos.overview: Byomkesh is appointed to discover the truth behind the mysterious death of Henna Mullick, a guest at the Samaddar family home.

videos.title: Rohoshyomoy Mouth Organ
videos.overview: Byomkesh interrogates the members of the Samaddar family to find Henna's assailant.

videos.title: Deshbhager Khesharat
videos.overview: As Byomkesh goes undercover, he unearths a larger conspiracy in the concluding part of the story.

videos.title: Mrigaya
videos.overview: A sudden disappearance leaves everyone at the Chorabali estate in a fix. Byomkesh reaches soon after and discovers several skeletons in the closet of the zamindari household.

videos.title: Shobdobhed
videos.overview: A tiger has been presumable roaming the estate as its growl can be heard often. While out on morning walk, Byomkesh and Ajit spot a mud hut in the middle of nowhere. Will the mystery culminate here?

videos.title: Prothom Pawrbo
videos.overview: Satyanweshi Byomkesh Bakshi, along with friend Ajit, embarks upon the thrilling journey of untangling a spine-chilling murder mystery where everyone is a suspect, and the truth has multiple faces.
